info.name: LayerZero OFT Transfer Discovery ofts API

params.name: chainNames
params.description: Comma-separated list of chain names to filter by

params.name: symbols
params.description: Comma-separated list of token symbols to filter by

params.name: protocols
params.description: Comma-separated list of protocol names to filter by

params.name: contractAddresses
params.description: Comma-separated list of contract addresses to filter by

items.docs: Get list of available OFTs with their deployments across chains

params.name: srcChainName
params.description: Source chain name where the OFT transfer originates

params.name: dstChainName
params.description: Destination chain name where the OFT will be received

params.name: oftAddress
params.description: Address of the OFT contract on the source chain

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount to transfer in the smallest unit (wei/satoshi equivalent)

params.name: to
params.description: Address of the recipient wallet (EVM hex or Solana base58)

params.name: validate
params.description: Whether to validate balances before creating transaction

params.name: options
params.description: Structured LayerZero execution options as JSON string. EXECUTOR OPTIONS: - lzReceive: Set gas limit and optional native drop for lzReceive execution - nativeDrops: Array of native token drops to specific addresses - composeOptions: Array of compose message execution settings with gas and native drop All numeric values for gas limits and native drops should be strings or numbers. Native drop amounts are in wei (e.g., "1000000000000000" = 0.001 ETH).

params.name: composeMsg
params.description: Compose message for advanced OFT operations (hex encoded)

params.name: oftCmd
params.description: OFT command for advanced operations (hex encoded)

items.docs: Create an OFT transfer transaction between chains
